instruction: Candid full-body photograph of a couple walking down a bright white clinic hallway. The woman in the black and white plaid shirt (R2) walks on the left, looking in the direction of the gesture. The man in the white t-shirt (R1) walks on the right, pointing forward and to the left with his right hand while holding her hand. Both wear blue shoe covers. Bright, even overhead indoor lighting illuminates the clean corridor, casting soft shadows on the floor.
elements: R1 points forward and to the left with his right hand while holding R2's hand
R2 looks in the direction of R1's pointing gesture rather than making the pointing gesture herself
R1 and R2 walk together while holding hands
Both R1 and R2 wear blue shoe covers
The interaction takes place in a bright white clinic hallway
